South End  •  Charlotte  •  Formerly Lost and Found, Reborn As Must Be Nice

The Story

A familiar corner, a whole new night

If you knew this corner as Lost and Found, you already know the address. What you do not know yet is what it became.

The space was fully renovated and reborn as Must Be Nice, an elevated neighborhood bar built for more than one kind of night. A martini after work. A cold pint during the game. A patio afternoon that turns into evening. A date night in the lounge. A late night when the room turns into a dance party.

That is the whole idea. One place on West Bland Street where the night can start one way and end another, with a 21 foot video wall inside, a big patio outside, and seating that is first come, first serve.

The Must Be Nice Guarantee

Love your night, or the next drink is on us

Come in, order a signature, and settle into your night. If you do not have the best night out in Charlotte, tell us before you leave and your next drink is on us. No fine print, no hard feelings. We would rather earn the next visit than argue about the first one.
